scripts.check-files: echo 'Total files in dist:' && find dist -type f | wc -l
scripts.deploy:staging: gh workflow run deploy-cpanel-staging.yml --repo sslnyx/qualitour-astro --ref main -f trigger=manual
scripts.test:staging: node --test scripts/test-transfer-cache.mjs scripts/test-seo.mjs scripts/test-seo-pages.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p "test_staging_*.py"
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.deploy:cloudflare-staging: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=qualitour-astro --branch=staging
